text: A woman, likely late teens to early twenties, stands barefoot in a flowing purple robe with gold trim and a high slit. Her skin is light-toned, hair long dark brown waves framing her face. She wears a deep V-neck top, black belt with ornate gold buckle, and draped cape. Pose: legs apart, arms slightly outstretched, head tilted forward. Appears to be mid-movement or posing for the camera against a plain gray background.
